_about: UK-specific pharmacogenomic dosing guidance, encoded verbatim-in-substance from the published UK sources named in 'sources'. This file is deliberately separate from the CPIC cache: CPIC and the UK sources do not always give the same starting dose, and a UK lab or oncology pharmacy team needs the UK answer alongside the international one. Each rule carries its own source id and the guidance version, so a later edition can be added beside this one rather than silently replacing it.

ukcb_dpyd_2020.name: UK Chemotherapy Board: Personalised medicine approach for fluoropyrimidine-based therapies
ukcb_dpyd_2020.scope: Adults starting fluoropyrimidine (5-fluorouracil, capecitabine, tegafur) chemotherapy in the UK.
ukcb_dpyd_2020.notes: Dose percentages are of the standard full dose for the regimen. A later edition of this guidance exists; it is not encoded here, and its recommendations may differ.

cersi_ugt1a1_2026.name: CERSI-PGx guideline for UGT1A1 genotype-guided irinotecan dosing
cersi_ugt1a1_2026.scope: Adults with an epithelial malignancy starting non-pegylated irinotecan, where UGT1A1 testing is available.
cersi_ugt1a1_2026.notes: No recommendation is made for rare malignancies such as sarcomas. Irinotecan formulations are not interchangeable: the evidence base is non-pegylated irinotecan, and liposomal irinotecan is not covered.

titration.text: Where a reduced starting dose is tolerated, escalate in increments of 12.5% of the full dose per cycle, to a maximum of two increments, guided by toxicity.

dpyd.combination_rule: Where more than one DPYD variant is present, the loss of DPD activity is additive; use the genotype group in group_table that matches the combined genotype.

groups.label: No actionable DPYD variant detected
groups.advice: Standard starting dose. Note that absence of these four variants does not exclude DPD deficiency from other causes.

groups.label: Heterozygous *2A or *13
groups.advice: Reduce the starting dose to 50% of the full dose, or use an alternative agent. If 50% is tolerated, escalate towards 75%.

groups.label: Heterozygous c.2846A>T or c.1236G>A (HapB3)
groups.advice: Reduce the starting dose to 50% of the full dose. If tolerated, escalate towards 75%, and to a maximum of 85% with caution.

groups.label: Compound heterozygous or homozygous for actionable DPYD variants
groups.advice: Residual DPD activity is between 0% and 50% depending on the combination. A fluoropyrimidine should be avoided, or used only at a markedly reduced dose with specialist input and therapeutic monitoring. Discuss an alternative agent.

ugt1a1.testing: Test UGT1A1 before starting irinotecan for an epithelial malignancy, where testing is available.

poor metabolizer.label: UGT1A1 poor metaboliser
poor metabolizer.advice: Reduce the cycle 1 irinotecan dose by 30%, for all indications. Thereafter titrate the dose on tolerability and neutrophil counts.

intermediate metabolizer.label: UGT1A1 intermediate metaboliser
intermediate metabolizer.advice: No dose reduction is recommended. The gene-drug interaction is recognised, but the evidence does not support a reduced starting dose for intermediate metabolisers.

ugt1a1.combined_regimen_note: For regimens containing both a fluoropyrimidine and irinotecan, wait for both the UGT1A1 and the DPYD result before prescribing.
